title: Wildfire ash cleanup for apartments
summary: Cleans balconies, windows, water containers, and entrances after wildfire smoke with low dust exposure.
content: Wildfire ash cleanup for apartments is a practical offline routine for wildfire cleanup. Wait for safe-return guidance and avoid cleanup while smoke or hot spots remain. Keep ash out of drinking water, food drying areas, children's play areas, and air intakes. Use damp wiping or other low-dust methods; do not blow ash into neighbors or rooms. Bag ash-contaminated disposable items and label suspect containers. People with asthma, heart/lung disease, pregnancy, elderly age, or infants should avoid ash exposure when possible.
steps: Bag ash-contaminated disposable items and label suspect containers.
